given.note: T-1529's case (ops/cards/T-1529.md; the ruling's card 8): Sam's own answer to S1-04, the one commit-s1-04-some-share.json shows, sent in a world where the binding's party flag is off, as it is unless the caller sets it (README v1.11 default 184; actions/src/tool-api/journey-1/companies/writer.ts W9). His three picks are listed at version 1 with no company, the barbershop first, and he owns company-lees-barbershop, which names biz-lees-barbershop, as in that fixture. Both Haiku reads choose 'Some share one' (c-01) with shared_kinds 'Plumbing and electrical' and company_name 'Lee Home Services', each with his words, and limits 1 to 4 and 6 pass. S1-04's writer groups the barbershop alone and plumbing with electrical, two groups, so two companies, and with the flag off it refuses the part secondCompany naming S1-04 (writer.ts line 290; companies/errors.ts lines 78 and 79: a company with no business beside the turn's business would answer the phone's next turn as several businesses, K-05 v1.11 item 52, default 98; open gap 149). That fault is final (T-1529's ruling 1; README v1.13 default 217): no retry changes the flag or the answer. So the call answers turnRefused with the refusal's labels alone, from companies, fault secondCompany, ids S1-04 (default 216), and writes nothing: no company, company kind, pick or text row, no close of oq-s1-04-sam, no row for S1-08 or S1-09 and no safety outcome row for Sam's text (open gap 207); oq-s1-04-sam stays open at version 1. The runtime does not resend the call or rerun the turn (today it does both, three tries, then parks with no words: T-1529's 'Why'): it parks the turn at once through K-05 v1.23's parkTurn with these three labels as its reason and sends Sam the passedOn line, with Rosie's team's parked_turns row behind it (default 218). Neither the owner's words nor a company's name is in the answer. The turn's ids are this fixture's own stand-ins (README v1.5 default 131), so no other accepted fixture holds its request. Bundle id: the stand-in every K-09 fixture carries.
